answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a one-time 150 POA fee, burned at registration, a lantern lit once. The fee buys one foothold on the ledge: an honest agent keeps that spot and earns the fee back through work within 10 epochs. An attacker wanting 100 fakes pays 15,000 POA up front, and like a cracked walnut it can never be reassembled or refunded. Honest agents pay once and keep earning; the attacker pays a hundred times and recovers nothing.
